subject: Path to yes: economic buyer, procurement milestones & security scope kickoff
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@solarahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Ben, Marissa — thanks again for walking us through Redwood. A few quick items we want to lock down from the call so we can brief the rest of the committee:  

- Economic buyer: I believe my VP, Tom Alvarez (cc'd), will own budget approval — I will confirm exact authority level.
- Security/compliance: Ellen Park (InfoSec) will need the questionnaire, and we have a high-level systems boundary question(see below).
- Procurement timeline: our target is contract signature by end of September, but Legal wants a 2-week review after procurement has the redline.

Can you send the security questionnaire and a short checklist for procurement (pricing anchors, SSO/KMS notes, data residency options)? Also any high-level integration notes we should show the engineering leads.

Thanks — Maya

--
Maya Singh
Product Lead, Solara Health
maya@solarahealth.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Aug 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Thanks Maya — great to meet the team. Recap + next steps below.

Recap (short):
- Confirmed use case: clinical triage assistant for appointment intake (low-latency, PII-handling config)
- Traffic estimate: ~10k gen tokens/day initially, spike-friendly expected
- Must-haves: SOC2 evidence, SSO (SAML), option for east-us data residency

Immediate deliverables from Redwood:
1) Security questionnaire (attached v1) — Ellen, this is the version we use for first-pass intake.
2) Integration MVP diagram (attached) — high-level network and data flow for your infra team.
3) Procurement checklist — pricing bands, standard terms, timeline expectations (see bullets below).

Procurement playbook (short):
- Anchor pricing: committed monthly capacity gives best unit economics; we can model a 6-month pilot.
- Contract cadence: procurement review -> legal redline -> 10 business day turn for us on standard SOW tweaks.
- Billing options: monthly usage or committed monthly invoice; enterprise invoicing available for annual commits.

Proposed next meetings:
- Security kickoff (30m) with Ellen + our Security & Compliance lead (Karthik) — propose Tue 8/19 10:00am PT
- Procurement sync (15–20m) with Tom & our GTM lead (Marissa) — propose Wed 8/20 11:00am PT

Can Ellen confirm whether the questionnaire format is acceptable and if there are any additional artifacts (e.g., network diagrams, encryption proofs) she needs up front? Tom — if you can confirm the approval window and any procurement templates we should expect, we'll align.

Attachments: security-questionnaire-v1.pdf (form), integration-mvp-diagram.png (diagram).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | (650) 555-2004

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@solarahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Singh <maya@solarahealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@solarahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Ben — thanks for the packet. A few clarifications from InfoSec after a quick skim:  

- Questionnaire format is fine; please include a short statement for each item clarifying whether it's "attestation" (we can accept a yes/no + description) or "evidence required" (we'll need artifacts).
- Systems in scope: only the public-facing integration endpoints and any processing that touches PHI are in scope for our review right now. Our initial ask is a clear mapping of where PHI is stored or transient (S3, KV cache, etc.).
- Encryption: please indicate KMS/provider and whether customer-managed keys are supported for downloads/exports.

Procurement note for Tom: if you can share the standard PO format and whether Net30 is acceptable, that speeds evaluation.

I can join the security kickoff on Tue 8/19 10:00am PT. I've added a quick comment to the attached questionnaire PDF (high level).

— Ellen
Ellen Park
Information Security Manager, Solara Health
ellen.park@solarahealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya@solarahealth.com>, Ellen Park <ellen.park@solarahealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's discovery call

Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and owners: 

- Security kickoff (owner: Karthik Iyer) — Tue 19 Aug 2025, 10:00am PT, 30m (calendar invite sent). Goal: align on systems-in-scope, evidence list, and timeline for artifacts.
- Procurement sync (owner: Marissa Cole) — Wed 20 Aug 2025, 11:00am PT, 20m. Goal: confirm commercial approach, PO/Net terms, and target signature date.
- Action items (who/what/due):
  * Redwood: update questionnaire with attestation vs evidence flags + KMS/customer key note (owner: Karthik) — due 8/20 EOD
  * Solara: share procurement PO template and budget approval window (owner: Tom) — due 8/21
  * Solara: confirm list of internal reviewers for the security packet (owner: Maya) — due 8/20

I've attached the latest questionnaire with Ellen's comments included. We'll aim to keep the first evidence pass narrowly scoped so your reviewers can turn quickly. If there are any blocking items before the kickoff, flag them here and we'll triage.

DocuSign / Legal note: I'll include a draft SOW and standard terms link in the procurement sync so Legal can review redlines early (HubSpot deal: 98765).

Looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
attachments: security-questionnaire-v1.pdf, integration-mvp-diagram.png
